implementation.mixture: Temperature-dependent Wilke Phi evaluated using the same source pure viscosities and existing reciprocal-log Darcy face temperature.
implementation.common_branch: alpha=0 exactly retains the original common power law; alpha=1 is nominal source mixture. This diagnostic branch does not qualify the source mixture by itself.
implementation.thermodynamic_coupling: Only positive mobility changes; existing shared species flux, carried enthalpy, energy/entropy accounting and all states remain. No added heat/storage/latent or reaction source.
implementation.parameter_change: 16 literature entries added; 4 assumed species viscosity factors removed. Legacy common-law reference/exponent only serve the explicitly weighted common branch. P19 added one assumed fixed diagnostic temperature array.
implementation.source_accuracy: Equality to a source formula and internal identities do not establish experimental mixture, finite-density or confined-pore accuracy.

constitutive.scope: Numerical implementation and mixture identities, not new independent experimental accuracy; P19 source values reused. Pure chemical masses and fitted correlation masses remain distinct.
